title: Publicize keeping the sea clean at marine works sites, fish wholesale markets and vessels at mooring areas
向海事工程工地、漁市場和在碇泊區的船隻宣傳保持海上清潔。
向海事工程工地丶渔市场和在碇泊区的船只宣传保持海上清洁。
content: Marine Department conducted visit and inspection of vessels related to marine works and vessels moored at fish wholesale markets and various mooring areas to publicize keeping the sea clean to person in charge of vessels and to ensure any refuse generated at these vessels would be properly contained and disposed.
海事處探訪和檢查靠泊在漁市場、碇泊區和與海事工程有關的船隻，向有關負責人宣傳保持海上清潔和確保在這些船上產生的垃圾能被適當裝載和棄置。
海事处探访和检查靠泊在渔市场丶碇泊区和与海事工程有关的船只，向有关负责人宣传保持海上清洁和确保在这些船上产生的垃圾能被适当装载和弃置。

content: To promote the key messages of the Clean Shorelines Campaign, the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) distributed reusable cutlery sets to beach-goers at Shek O Beach, encouraging them to work together in keeping the shorelines clean and not use disposable items. Apart from EPD colleagues, local District Council member Mrs. CHAN LEE Pui-ying and representatives from Shek O Residents Association Limited, Shek O Women's Association Limited, Leisure and Cultural Services Department and Southern District Office also participated.
為推廣海岸清潔運動的主要訊息，環境保護署（環保署）在石澳泳灘向市民派發可重用的餐具套裝，以鼓勵市民一同保持海岸清潔及不要使用即棄物品。除環保署的同事外，當區區議員陳李佩英女士及來自石澳居民會有限公司、石澳婦女會有限公司、康樂及文化事務署及南區民政事務處的代表亦參與是次活動。
为推广海岸清洁运动的主要讯息，环境保护署（环保署）在石澳泳滩向市民派发可重用的餐具套装，以鼓励市民一同保持海岸清洁及不要使用即弃物品。除环保署的同事外，当区区议员陈李佩英女士及来自石澳居民会有限公司丶石澳妇女会有限公司丶康乐及文化事务署及南区民政事务处的代表亦参与是次活动。

content: The 12-year established Hong Kong Cleanup is part of a global year-round effort to keep our environment free from trash and safe for people and animals. Anyone can participate and it’s free. Once you have signed up for a Coastal Cleanup with your preferred date and location, we’ll invite you to participate in an educational seminar to show you how to organize a cleanup. To join over 100,000 volunteers, please visit:www.HKCleanup.org
「清潔香港」活動已在香港成立了12周年，這項活動是橫跨全年的國際運動中的一項環節。其目標是保持環境清潔，使人類和動物免受垃圾問題所威脅。任何人士都可以免費參加這項活動。假若您報名參加在指定日期舉行的海灘清潔活動後，我們將會邀請您參加教育講座，並且向您講解如何組織清潔活動。若您有興趣與超過10,000名義工一起行動，請瀏覽網址 www.HKCleanup.org 。
「清洁香港」活动已在香港成立了12周年，这项活动是横跨全年的国际运动中的一项环节。其目标是保持环境清洁，使人类和动物免受垃圾问题所威胁。任何人士都可以免费参加这项活动。假若您报名参加在指定日期举行的海滩清洁活动後，我们将会邀请您参加教育讲座，并且向您讲解如何组织清洁活动。若您有兴趣与超过10,000名义工一起行动，请浏览网址 www.HKCleanup.org 。

title: Marine Conservation, Cleaner and Greener Shorelines - Wu Kai Sha, Stanley Beach
海岸保育及清潔 - 烏溪沙，赤柱正灘
海岸保育及清洁 - 乌溪沙，赤柱正滩
content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

title: Coastal Watch Ocean Seminar

content: The Coastal Watch team will be holding three Ocean Seminars which will help people learn about coastal ecology and conservation and understand the importance of our coastlines and the need to protect them. The first seminar will include a review of the plastic pellet disaster of 2012, the fascinating coastal lives which inhabit our natural coasts and how modern “seafood culture” affects our oceans. Details of the seminar can be found at this webpage.
世界自然基金會香港分會(WWF) 誠邀公眾出席由育養海岸團隊舉辦的三場海洋講座，我們將以不同形式及主題與大眾分享各類海洋生態及保育資訊，務求加深大眾對海洋垃圾及生態的認知，從而提高個人環保意識。 首場講座將包括2012年膠粒事件兩周年回顧、海鮮文化對生態造成的危機及香港海岸的有趣生物等。詳情請參閱網頁。
世界自然基金会香港分会(WWF) 诚邀公众出席由育养海岸团队举办的三场海洋讲座，我们将以不同形式及主题与大众分享各类海洋生态及保育资讯，务求加深大众对海洋垃圾及生态的认知，从而提高个人环保意识。 首场讲座将包括2012年胶粒事件两周年回顾丶海鲜文化对生态造成的危机及香港海岸的有趣生物等。详情请参阅网页。

title: CS Inspects Cleaning Work at Lap Sap Wan
政務司司長視察垃圾灣
政务司司长视察垃圾湾
content: The Chief Secretary for Administration, Mrs Carrie Lam, inspected cleaning work at Lap Sap Wan, Shek O, on 28 July 2015 and received a briefing on the work on shoreline cleaning by various departments. Mrs Lam was accompanied by the Secretary for Food and Health, Dr Ko Wing-man; the Acting Secretary for the Environment, Ms Christine Loh; the Director of Environmental Protection, Ms Anissa Wong; and the Director of Food and Environmental Hygiene, Miss Vivian Lau.
政務司司長林鄭月娥於七月二十八日下午在食物及衞生局局長高永文、署理環境局局長陸恭蕙、環境保護署（環保署）署長王倩儀及食物環境衞生署（食環署）署長劉利群的陪同下，視察在石澳垃圾灣進行的清潔行動，並聽取部門匯報有關海岸清潔的工作。
政务司司长林郑月娥於七月二十八日下午在食物及衞生局局长高永文丶署理环境局局长陆恭蕙丶环境保护署（环保署）署长王倩仪及食物环境衞生署（食环署）署长刘利群的陪同下，视察在石澳垃圾湾进行的清洁行动，并听取部门汇报有关海岸清洁的工作。

title: 海岸清潔 18 區巡迴展覽
content: You are welcome to visit the Clean Shorelines Roving Exhibition, which is launched by the Interdepartmental Working Group on Clean Shorelines to educate the public on the sources of marine refuse and its impact on the environment. Travelling throughout the territory at 18 districts, the exhibition is aimed at seeking community support to protect our scenic shorelines and marine ecology. In addition to information panels, a game booth will also be set up at the exhibition venues on Sundays with different types of marine refuse on display. For details of the schedule and venues of the exhibition, please click here.
歡迎參觀海岸清潔跨部門工作小組於全港18區舉辦的「海岸清潔」巡迴展覽。巡迴展覽向市民介紹海上垃圾的來源和影響，以喚起大眾一同保持香港優美的海岸及豐富的海岸生態。除展板外，各展覽地點在周日下午亦設有攤位，展示所收集的海上垃圾和進行與海岸清潔相關的小遊戲。請按此了解展期和地點。
欢迎参观海岸清洁跨部门工作小组於全港18区举办的「海岸清洁」巡回展览。巡回展览向市民介绍海上垃圾的来源和影响，以唤起大众一同保持香港优美的海岸及丰富的海岸生态。除展板外，各展览地点在周日下午亦设有摊位，展示所收集的海上垃圾和进行与海岸清洁相关的小游戏。请按此了解展期和地点。

title: “Out to Sea?” Special Exhibition of the Plastic Garbage Project hosted by Hong Kong Science Museum
香港科學館 「海洋怒吼」塑膠垃圾關注計劃專題展覽
香港科学馆 「海洋怒吼」塑胶垃圾关注计划专题展览
content:
This exhibition jointly presented by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department and Consulate General of Switzerland combines elements of science and art. Plastic flotsam collected from the beach cleaning operations in the North Sea, Hawaii, the Baltic Sea and the rest of the world is displayed with the aim of arousing public awareness of plastic waste. In addition, the exhibition also makes use of different video footage and interactive exhibits featuring unique designs. Through the exhibition, visitors can gain an in-depth understanding of the chemical composition, classification and recycling processes of different plastic materials, and also learn about the harmful effects of plastic waste on birds and marine animals. The aim is to let us realise that we must curtail our consumption of plastic and encourage the recycling of plastic immediately. To enrich the educational experience of the exhibition, students of the "Project WeCan" will collect plastic garbage from the beach, classify them, and make different works of art using plastic garbage for display in the exhibition.

Exhibition Period: 27-11-2015 (Fri) – 17-02-2016 (Wed)
Venue: Special Exhibition Hall, Hong Kong Science Museum

For details please visit the Hong Kong Science Museum website

這個由康樂及文化事務署與瑞士總領事館聯合主辦的展覽融合了科學與藝術，透過展示由北大西洋、夏威夷、波羅的海和世界各地沙灘收集回來的海洋塑膠垃圾，從而喚起公眾對塑膠垃圾的關注。除此之外，展覽亦包括多套錄像節目及設計獨特的互動展品，讓市民深入認識各種塑膠的化學成份、分類和回收過程，了解塑膠垃圾如何傷害鳥類和海洋動物，反思減少消耗塑膠產品的重要，積極支持回收塑膠行動。參與「學校起動」計劃的學生更親身到海灘收集塑膠垃圾，分類並創作藝術作品，在展覽期間一同展出。

title: Ocean Art Walk 2016
海洋藝術展 2016
海洋艺术展 2016
content:
To help showing how consumerist lifestyle affects the health of our oceans and encourage everyone to take immediate action, Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation (YAF), Ocean Recovery Alliance and Link Asset Management Limited are collaborating to present Ocean Art Walk 2016. The exhibition will transform Link’s Stanley Plaza into a large walk-in aquarium featuring artwork, installations and a physical theatre performance. Created by over 1,000 professional local artists and talented young people, the installations primarily made with waste and recycled materials are presented to inspire young people to take initiatives to protect our ocean environment. Please visit the website for details.

Duration: 1 to 24 April 2016
Venue: Stanley Plaza

title: Marine litter educational leaflet is available for free collection
「海洋垃圾」教育單張 即日起於各區免費派發
「海洋垃圾」教育单张 即日起於各区免费派发
content: To help visualize the importance of keeping litter out of the marine environment and give people tips on how to reduce waste, the Coastal Watch team will be releasing its first Marine Litter Educational Leaflet. With its fun illustrations and simple explanations, the leaflet describes the sources of marine litter and its consequences on marine life. It also explains ten practical ways to effectively reduce garbage in the marine environment. The first batch of both English and Chinese versions is now ready for free collection at more than 10 locations. Electronic versions of the leaflets may also be downloaded from Coastal Watch’s website.

為更進一步鼓勵公眾實踐「源頭減廢」的理念，「育養海岸」特別製作首份關於「海洋垃圾」的教育單張，以深入淺出的方式配以趣味插畫，詳列香港海洋垃圾源頭及對本地生態的影響，帶大眾了解「海洋垃圾漂流記」；而且附有十種減少海洋垃圾的方法，提醒大眾在日常生活中實踐，合力育養海岸。

此教育單張備有中英文版本，首批印製單張現於全港超過十個地點免費派發，數量有限，先到先得！市民可於「育養海岸」計劃網頁下載網上版本。

为更进一步鼓励公众实践「源头减废」的理念，「育养海岸」特别制作首份关於「海洋垃圾」的教育单张，以深入浅出的方式配以趣味插画，详列香港海洋垃圾源头及对本地生态的影响，带大众了解「海洋垃圾漂流记」；而且附有十种减少海洋垃圾的方法，提醒大众在日常生活中实践，合力育养海岸。

此教育单张备有中英文版本，首批印制单张现於全港超过十个地点免费派发，数量有限，先到先得！市民可於「育养海岸」计划网页下载网上版本。

环境运动委员会 海岸保育及清洁活动 (海星湾)
content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

title: ‘Marine Litter in Hong Kong Waters: Stopgaps and Solutions’ Public Forum (The Earth Day)
「香港海上垃圾：治標與治本」 公眾研討會
content:
Throughout 2017, the Hong Kong Maritime Museum in partnership with WWF-Hong Kong will present a series of three public forums exploring the issues around marine pollution and conservation in Hong Kong. The forums will bring together experts and provide opportunities for members of the public to learn more about the situation in Hong Kong and current efforts to address these issues.

Date: 22 April 2017 (Saturday)
Venue: Hong Kong Maritime Museum
Time: 16:00-18:00
Chinese (Cantonese) with simultaneous translation in English.

Attendance at the forum is free of charge, please register in advance at education@hkmaritimemuseum.org. For details, please visit the webpage of Hong Kong Maritime Museum.

content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

title: Hong Kong Green Day 2018

content:
Echoing the World Environment Day initiated by the United Nations in 1972, the Green Council has proudly staged the Hong Kong Green Day (HKGD) since 2013. HKGD activities annually encourage corporations and the general public to consider and take actions to make Hong Kong “greener”.

HKGD 2018 Kick-off Ceremony
Date: 5 June 2018
Time: 4:00pm - 6:00pm
Venue: Level 1 Fantasy Island, Maritime Square, Tsing Yi

Please visit the website or Facebook for the details.

聯合國在一九七二年將每年六月五日指定為「世界環境日」，以喚醒各國保護環境的重要性。環保促進會為響應聯合國的呼籲，在二○一三年發起「香港綠色日」以提高市民的環保意識，共建綠色香港。

詳情見網頁和Facebook.

content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

title: Environmental Campaign Committee Marine Conservation, Cleaner and Greener Shorelines Activity at Castle Peak Beach

环境运动委员会 海岸保育及清洁活动 (三门仔)
content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

content: Through activities such as collection of debris, compiling records, analysing data and group discussion, Student Environmental Protection Ambassadors can understand more about the status and causes of shorelines pollution, and how to take practical action to protect the shorelines.
學生環境保護大使通過收集海灘垃圾、填寫紀錄、分析及整理數據和小組討論，可明白海岸污染的情況及原因，以及如何以行動保護香港的海岸。
学生环境保护大使通过收集海滩垃圾丶填写纪录丶分析及整理数据和小组讨论，可明白海岸污染的情况及原因，以及如何以行动保护香港的海岸。

content:
Department of Chemistry, City University of Hong Kong is organising a guided tour for general public with coastal cleanup at Shui Hau of Lantau. The activity is supported by Environmental Campaign Committee and Environmental Conservation Fund.

Please visit the website and the Facebook of ECF “Shui Hau Magnification”- Upstanding Human Disturbances on Horseshoe Crabs for the details.

香港城市大學化學系將在大嶼山水口舉辦公眾導賞及清潔海灘行動。是次活動由環保基金及環境運動委員會贊助。

環保基金 「水口放大鏡」－調查人為干擾對馬蹄蟹的影響：透過導賞引領參加者去認識馬蹄蟹及欣賞水口的獨特生態，以及身體力行去清潔海岸，讓參加者感受海岸垃圾對環境、生態的影響，藉此反思日常生活，並鼓勵大家減少使用塑膠、即棄產品，養成重用和廢物回收等習慣。
有關項目的詳情，請見項目網頁及活動facebook。

香港城市大学化学系将在大屿山水口举办公众导赏及清洁海滩行动。是次活动由环保基金及环境运动委员会赞助。

环保基金「水口放大镜」－调查人为干扰对马蹄蟹的影响：透过导赏引领参加者去认识马蹄蟹及欣赏水口的独特生态，以及身体力行去清洁海岸，让参加者感受海岸垃圾对环境、生态的影响，借此反思日常生活，并鼓励大家减少使用塑胶、即弃产品，养成重用和废物回收等习惯。
有关项目的详情，请见项目网页及活动facebook。

title: Coastal Cleanup at Lung Kwu Tan by The Education University of Hong Kong
香港教育大學龍鼓灘海岸清潔活動
香港教育大学龙鼓滩海岸清洁活动
content: The Education University of Hong Kong is organising a coastal cleanup activity at Lung Kwu Tan of Tuen Mun in the afternoon of 20 February. Participants will collect and sort the trash during the cleanup event. This event aim to raise public awareness of the importance of waste reduction at source and encourage the public to put waste reduction into practice. All participants need to bring their own gloves and tongs. To prevent the spread of COVID-19 in the community, all participants must wear masks throughout the cleanup event and will be paired up in groups of two.
香港教育大學將會在2月20日下午在屯門龍鼓灘舉辦海岸清潔活動。參加者將會把收集到的垃圾進行分類回收，此活動的目的是希望參加者能藉此喚醒市民對源頭減廢的關注和其重要性，並且推廣減廢概念給人們實踐。如有意參加是次海岸清潔活動的市民需自備手套和鐵夾。其次，為防止2019冠狀病毒的傳播，參加者必須全程佩戴口罩和需要以二人為一組的形式進行。
香港教育大学將会在2月20日下午在屯门龙鼓滩举办海岸清洁活动。参加者將会把收集到的垃圾进行分类回收，此活动的目的是希望参加者能藉此唤醒市民对源头减废的关注和其重要性，並且推广减废概念给人们实践。如有意参加是次海岸清洁活动的市民需自备手套和铁夹。其次，为防止2019冠状病毒的传播，参加者必须全程佩戴口罩和需要以二人为一组的形式进行。

content: The Beach Clean Up program aims to broaden students’ horizons by exposing them to unique experiences. Teachers will lead students to hike through challenging and different terrains of Sai Kung Country Park and Beaches. The students will learn ways to protect the environment and help greening the parks and beaches. The program aims to develop positive attitudes and values on the environment as well as enhancing physical strength and fitness. Students will meet teachers at designated locations daily and travel to the program site. This program incorporates the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals of Life on Land, Life Below Water and Responsible consumption and production, and aims to nurture students to be balanced and passionate.

content: Ghost Net Hunting Volunteering Squad is organising a coastal cleanup activity at Lap Sap Wan of Southern. This activity is open to public. (Please refer to Chinese version in details and registration)

鬼網義工行動組將在南區垃圾灣舉辦海岸清潔活動。此活動開放予公眾人士參與。我們「鬼網義工行動組」是一群熱心清理水底垃圾的潛水員，主力清理棄置魚網 （俗稱鬼網）。希望利用我們的潛水技能回饋海洋，令海洋回復健康。除了水底垃圾，我們也關注海岸線的海洋垃圾，令非潛水員的市民也可以參與其中，理解海洋的重要性。歡迎成為「鬼網義工行動組」一份子。如有興趣人士可以聯絡我們，一起清潔海岸線及水底垃圾，可聯絡 ：+852-98676474 （WhatsApp）或deve.divehk@gmail.com。

鬼网义工行动组将在南区垃圾湾举办海岸清洁活动。此活动开放予公众人士参与。我们「鬼网义工行动组」是一群热心清理水底垃圾的潜水员，主力清理弃置鱼网 （俗称鬼网）。希望利用我们的潜水技能回馈海洋，令海洋回复健康。除了水底垃圾，我们也关注海岸线的海洋垃圾，令非潜水员的市民也可以参与其中，理解海洋的重要性。欢迎成为「鬼网义工行动组」一份子。如有兴趣人士可以联络我们，一起清洁海岸线及水底垃圾，可联络 ：+852-98676474 （WhatsApp）或deve.divehk@gmail.com。

title: Coastal Cleanup at Shek O Main Beach by A Plastic Ocean Foundation
A Plastic Ocean Foundation 石澳正灘海岸清潔活動
A Plastic Ocean Foundation 石澳正滩海岸清洁活动
content: A Plastic Ocean Foundation is organizing a coastal cleanup activity at Shek O Main Beach (ungazetted beach area) of Southern. A Plastic Ocean Foundation is trying to remove One Tonne of rubbish from our coastlines. They would also like to bring up awareness about the etiquette during outdoor activities and discuss the rubbish pollution around the area of Shek O Main Beach. This activity is open to public. You may enrol by emailing us at general@aplasticocean.foundation or via the mobile application "山‧灘拯救隊 Nature Rescue" for details and registration.

A Plastic Ocean Foundation 將在南區石澳正灘（非憲報公布的泳灘範圍）舉辦海岸清潔活動。A Plastic Ocean Foundation 今年的目標是在香港清理一公噸的海灘垃圾，並藉着帶領公眾進行戶外清潔活動提升參加者對戶外禮儀和海洋垃圾的關注。此活動開放予公眾人士參與。有興趣參與人士可電郵至 general@aplasticocean.foundation 或經「山‧灘拯救隊Nature Rescue」流動應用程式報名及了解活動詳情。

A Plastic Ocean Foundation 将在南区石澳正滩（非宪报公布的泳滩范围）举办海岸清洁活动。A Plastic Ocean Foundation 今年的目标是在香港清理一公吨的海滩垃圾，并借着带领公众进行户外清洁活动提升参加者对户外礼仪和海洋垃圾的关注。此活动开放予公众人士参与。有兴趣参与人士可电邮至 general@aplasticocean.foundation 或经「山‧滩拯救队Nature Rescue」流动应用程式报名及了解活动详情。

A Plastic Ocean Foundation 赤柱正滩海岸清洁活动
content: A Plastic Ocean Foundation is organizing a coastal cleanup activity at Stanley Main Beach (Ungazetted beach area) of Southern. A Plastic Ocean Foundation is trying to remove One Tonne of rubbish from our coastlines. They would also like to bring up awareness about the etiquette during outdoor activities and discuss the rubbish pollution around the area. This activity is open to public. You may enrol via the mobile application "山‧灘拯救隊 Nature Rescue" for details and registration.
A Plastic Ocean Foundation 將在南區赤柱正灘（非憲報公布的泳灘範圍）舉辦海岸清潔活動。A Plastic Ocean Foundation 今年的目標是在香港清理一公噸的海灘垃圾，並藉着帶領公眾進行戶外清潔活動提升參加者對戶外禮儀和海洋垃圾的關注。此活動開放予公眾人士參與。有興趣參與人士可經「山‧灘拯救隊Nature Rescue」流動應用程式報名及了解活動詳情。
A Plastic Ocean Foundation 将在南区赤柱正滩（非宪报公布的泳滩范围）举办海岸清洁活动。A Plastic Ocean Foundation 今年的目标是在香港清理一公吨的海滩垃圾，并借着带领公众进行户外清洁活动提升参加者对户外礼仪和海洋垃圾的关注。此活动开放予公众人士参与。有兴趣参与人士可经「山‧滩拯救队Nature Rescue」流动应用程式报名及了解活动详情。
